summary: Mid-America Apartments, L.P. filed a preliminary prospectus supplement (424B5, shelf takedown) for an offering of senior unsecured notes, with terms including principal amount, coupon and maturity left blank in this preliminary pricing supplement. Interest will be payable semi-annually beginning 2027, and the notes will rank pari passu with existing and future senior unsecured debt. Joint book-running managers named include J.P. Morgan, Mizuho, Truist Securities, US Bancorp and Wells Fargo Securities, settling via DTC/Clearstream/Euroclear. This is a routine debt capital raise, not a special situation; watch final pricing, coupon and spread to Treasuries.
